title: Solubility rules: soluble (aq) vs precipitate (s)
equation: ion pair -> soluble (aq)  OR  insoluble (s) precipitate

title: Ideal gas law: PV = nRT  ->  P = nRT/V
Dalton's law: P_i = X_i * P_total
equation: P_i = X_i * P_total,   X_i = n_i / n_total,   sum(P_i) = P_total

title: Graham's law: rate(1)/rate(2) = sqrt(M2/M1)
Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution: f(v) ~ v^2 exp(-Mv^2 / 2RT)
Real-gas compressibility: Z = PV / nRT (van der Waals)
Molar volume at STP: V = n x 22.4 L/mol
equation: V = n * 22.4 L/mol  (at STP, 0 C and 1 atm)

title: Reaction energy diagram: dH = H_products - H_reactants
equation: dH = H_products - H_reactants;  dH<0 exothermic, dH>0 endothermic

title: Calorimetry: q = m c dT
Hess's law: ΔH_total = ΔH1 + ΔH2
Bond enthalpy: ΔH = Σ(bonds broken) − Σ(bonds formed)
Heating curve: q = m·c·ΔT (slopes), q = m·L (plateaus)
equation: q = m*c*ΔT (warming) ; q = m*L (phase change, T constant)

title: Molarity & dilution: M = n/V, M1V1 = M2V2
Beer–Lambert law: A = ε·b·c
Colligative properties: dTf = -i*Kf*m, dTb = +i*Kb*m
Rate law: rate = k[A]^m [B]^n
Order from graphs: linear plot reveals order (0: [A], 1: ln[A], 2: 1/[A])
equation: 0th: [A] vs t linear  |  1st: ln[A] vs t linear  |  2nd: 1/[A] vs t linear

title: Integrated rate laws: [A] vs t for 0th/1st/2nd order
First-order half-life: t(1/2) = ln2 / k
Arrhenius equation: k = A e^(-Ea/RT)
Rate-determining step: rate set by the slow step
Catalysis: lowers Ea, leaves dH unchanged
Collision theory: fraction with E > Ea ~ e^(-Ea/RT)
Equilibrium constant: K = [C] / ([A][B])
Reaction quotient: compare Q to K
equation: Q vs K: Q<K forward, Q>K reverse, Q=K equilibrium

title: Le Chatelier: a stress shifts equilibrium to oppose it
equation: stress -> system shifts to partially counteract the change

title: ICE table: Kc = [C]/([A][B]) solved for x
equation: Kc = x / (C0 - x)^2  for  A + B <-> C

title: Solubility product: Ksp = 4 s^3 for a 1:2 salt
Common-ion effect: s = Ksp / [Cl-] for AgCl
equation: s(s + C) = Ksp,  so  s ~ Ksp / [Cl-] when [Cl-] is large

title: pH and pOH: pH = -log[H+], pH + pOH = 14
Strong acid/base pH: pH = -log(C) or pH = 14 + log(C)
equation: strong acid: pH = -log(C); strong base: pH = 14 + log(C)

title: Weak acid Ka: Ka = x^2/(C - x), x = [H+]
Buffer: pH = pKa + log([A-]/[HA])
Strong-strong titration: equivalence at pH 7
equation: moles base = Cb*Vb; pH from excess H+ or OH- in total volume

title: Weak acid + strong base titration: at half-equivalence pH = pKa
equation: pH = pKa + log([A-]/[HA]);  at half-eq pH = pKa

title: Diprotic acid titration: two equivalence points, V(eq2) = 2*V(eq1)
equation: pH = pKa1 + log([HA-]/[H2A]) then pH = pKa2 + log([A2-]/[HA-]); Veq2 = 2*Veq1

title: Salt hydrolysis: conjugate of the WEAK partner sets acidic/basic/neutral
equation: NH4+ + H2O -> NH3 + H3O+ (acidic); A- + H2O -> HA + OH- (basic)

title: Acid-base indicators: color flips over pH = pKa(In) +- 1
equation: [In-]/[HIn] = 10^(pH - pKa);  midpoint color at pH = pKa

title: Entropy: S(gas) > S(liquid) > S(solid); melting/boiling give ΔS > 0
equation: DeltaS = S(final) - S(initial);  S(gas) > S(liquid) > S(solid)

title: Gibbs free energy: dG = dH - T*dS
Spontaneity vs T: dG flips sign at T* = dH/dS
Free energy and equilibrium: dG = -R*T*ln(K)
Galvanic cell: e- flow anode -> cathode (oxidation/reduction)
equation: anode: oxidation (-);  cathode: reduction (+);  e- : anode -> cathode

title: Standard cell potential: E_cell = E_cathode - E_anode
Nernst equation: E = E0 - (RT/nF) ln Q
Faraday's law: n = I*t / (n_e*F)
Oxidation numbers: sum = overall charge
Percent composition: %X = n_X*A_X / M * 100
Mole ratio: n_product = n_reactant * (coef_p / coef_r)
Acid strength: Ka and pH of a weak acid (Ka = [H+][A-]/[HA])
equation: Ka = [H+][A-]/[HA];  for 0.10 M HA: [H+] = (-Ka + sqrt(Ka^2 + 4*Ka*C))/2,  pH = -log[H+]

title: Gas equilibrium: Kp = Kc (RT)^dn
equation: Kp = Kc * (R*T)^dn,  dn = (moles gas products) - (moles gas reactants),  R = 0.08206 L*atm/(mol*K)

title: Reaction energy profile: Ea barrier and dH
equation: dH = E(products) - E(reactants);  Ea(reverse) = Ea(forward) - dH

title: Molar mass of a gas: M = mRT / PV
equation: PV = nRT,  n = PV/(R*T),  M = m/n = m*R*T/(P*V),  R = 0.08206 L*atm/(mol*K)

title: Beer's law calibration: A = eps*b*c, read c = A/slope
equation: A = eps*b*c (Beer-Lambert);  unknown c = A(unknown)/slope,  slope = eps*b

title: Net dipole = vector sum of bond dipoles
equation: mu_net = vector sum of bond dipole vectors

title: Graham's law: rate_A/rate_B = sqrt(M_B/M_A)
van 't Hoff: T shifts K (endo vs exo)

topic: Strong vs weak at same concentration
title: Strong vs weak acid pH: weak gives higher pH
Redox electron transfer: LEO says GER
equation: oxidation: lose n e- ; reduction: gain n e-

title: Titration stoichiometry: M_titrant * V_eq = n_analyte
equation: M_titrant * V_eq = n_analyte ; n_analyte = C_a * V_a

title: Vapor pressure: ln P = -(dHvap/R)(1/T) + C
Raoult's law: P_soln = X_solvent * P_pure
Percent ionization: %ion = ([H+]/C)*100 rises on dilution
Buffer capacity: pH = pKa + log([A-]/[HA])
